release_notes: Keep printed activity-total OCR attached to the parsed layout so real total-mismatch recovery always runs when needed
Read printed activity totals with high-resolution OCR to prevent subtle total-digit errors
On a failed total, reread master-outlier rows first and then force an independent all-row OCR audit if the mismatch remains
Preserve and independently reread every physical split/MSA pipe part before recombining its exact length
Keep individual Pipe and Cleaning values at 1700 ft maximum and no more than two decimal places without rounding PDF measurements
